analyzed_vuln.description: `UnionFromFlatbuffer` deserializes union type IDs from IPC metadata and blindly casts each `int32_t` type id to `int8_t` (`type_codes.push_back(static_cast<int8_t>(id))`) without validating range/sign. This allows negative wrapped type codes to reach `arrow::UnionType::UnionType` in `arrow/cpp/src/arrow/type.cc`, which then indexes `child_ids_[type_code]` (line ~362). A negative `type_code` causes an out-of-bounds write before the vector buffer (heap-buffer-overflow).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In the IPC stream fuzz path (`FuzzIpcStream` -> `GetSchema` -> `FieldFromFlatbuffer` -> `ConcreteTypeFromFlatbuffer` -> `UnionFromFlatbuffer`), attacker-controlled flatbuffer union `typeIds` must include a value outside int8_t valid nonnegative range (e.g., >127 or negative), so truncation to `int8_t` yields a negative `type_code`. `union_()` then constructs `UnionType` and writes `child_ids_[type_code]`, triggering the crash.
